# C2PA fixtures

`c2pa-valid.jpg` is `legacy/1.4/image/jpeg/adobe-20220124-C.jpg` from the
[C2PA public test files](https://github.com/c2pa-org/public-testfiles). It is
provided by that project under CC BY-SA 4.0 for validator interoperability and
conformance testing.

`no-c2pa.svg` was created for ArcProof and intentionally contains no Content
Credentials. Tampered input is generated during tests by changing a copy of the
open fixture in memory; no additional media is committed.
